title: FinLLM-KG: Knowledge Graph-Enhanced LLMs for Financial Sentiment Analysis in Algorithmic Trading
abstract: arXiv:2610.36083v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent advances in Generative AI have substantially improved financial sentiment analysis through post-trained financial large language models (LLMs). However, existing approaches remain confined to predicting the sentiment of each article in isolation and operate as black boxes, which limits contextual understanding and hinders deployment in high-stakes financial decision-making. To this end, we introduce FinLLM-KG, a model-agnostic framework that combines causal LLMs with a financial knowledge graph, in order to inject temporally grounded, company-level knowledge from SEC 10-K filings at inference time, without updating model weights. Within FinLLM-KG, context is supplied either as a natural-language company profile or as a small set of relevance-ranked factual triples. This enables sentiment predictions to account for broader firm-level information rather than the article alone, at almost zero computational cost and for any causal LLM

translated_title: FinLLM-KG：面向算法交易中金融情感分析的知识图谱增强大语言模型
translated_abstract: 生成式人工智能的最新进展通过经过后训练的金融大语言模型（LLM）显著提升了金融情感分析的性能。然而，现有方法仍然局限于孤立地预测每篇文章的情感，并且以黑盒方式运行，这限制了上下文理解能力，也阻碍了其在高风险金融决策中的部署。为此，我们提出了FinLLM-KG，这是一个模型无关的框架，它将因果大语言模型与金融知识图谱相结合，以便在推理时注入来自SEC 10-K文件中具有时间依据的公司层面知识，而无需更新模型权重。在FinLLM-KG中，上下文既可以以自然语言公司简介的形式提供，也可以以少量按相关性排序的事实三元组的形式提供。这使得情感预测能够考虑更广泛的公司层面信息，而不仅仅是文章本身，且计算成本几乎为零，并适用于任何因果大语言模型。
tldr: 该论文提出FinLLM-KG框架，通过将因果大语言模型与金融知识图谱结合，在推理时注入来自SEC 10-K文件的公司层面知识，以近乎零计算成本提升了金融情感分析的上下文理解能力，且无需更新模型权重。
